'''Imperial escort fighters''' were [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] in use on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Shrike Squadron (Mandalore)|Shrike Squadron]] was made up of these type of fighters, which flew patterns around the [[City of Bone]], protecting it from outside attack. During the [[Battle of the City of Bone|battle]] in the city, the squadron flew an attack pattern with in the city in an attempt to quell the slave uprising. When [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Fenn Shysa]] commandeered a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|hovercraft]] to make their way out of the city, Shrike Squadron chased them towards the [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]].

However, due to the efforts of [[Tobbi Dala]], the doors were closed immediately after the hovercraft had escaped. The airspeeders crashed headlong into the city walls, creating a massive explosion which ignited the fuel and ammunition stored in the city. The blast consumed the city in flames killing all the Imperials within.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Battle-of-hoth-mcquarrie.jpg|thumb|left|200px|McQuarrie's concept art of the Rebel snowspeeder.]]
The design of the Imperial escort fighter seen in [[Star Wars (1977) 69|''Star Wars'' (1977) 69]], is nearly identical to concept artwork done by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] of the [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeder]]. This may indicate that these ships were of the same design or perhaps a precursor to the Rebel snowspeeder.

They appear similar or identical to the non-canon [[Tachyon fast-attack airspeeder]], which was probably based on the same concept art.
